faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JNCASR Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications for the JNCASR Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Engineer in JNCASR?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Engineer post in Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) as per the official notification released for the 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for JNCASR Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the JNCASR Project Engineer posts is Email. Interested and eligible candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Engineer post in JNCASR is 64 years. Age relaxation may be considered for candidates demonstrating exceptional merit, as mentioned in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Engineer at JNCASR?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Engineer position at JNCASR will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 60000 per month. This compensation is offered based on the experience and qualifications required for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Engineer post must possess a BE (Civil) degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience in handling major construction activities or civil works at pay level 08 or above.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for JNCASR Project Engineer Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for JNCASR Project Engineer Recruitment 2026. Candidates belonging to General/OBC, SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any fee to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Engineer posts at JNCASR involves two main stages: initial scrutiny of applications received, followed by an interview conducted by a committee, which will assess candidates based on their experience and qualifications.

faq.answer: The job location for the Project Engineer post at Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064. This position is based in a prominent scientific research institution.
